targeted_validation.initial_failures: Default test temporary directory was inaccessible; explicit workspace scratch used. Tuple reversal in a fixture was corrected before science.

reconciliation.scope: Late descriptive controls; fixed original baseline recipe, earlier-reader training cohort, current draft/menu features only.

shared_control_cpu_cost.scope: Shared CPU fit and all three controls; charge once, not per reused comparison.

remaining_dispatch: No unlanded mandatory job in the finite local selection; unavailable recipient interface and unperformed intervention/optional branches remain explicit dispositions.
filing: Final packet indexed beside results; current design/status indexes distinguish completed work from historical setup. Source-pinned plans remain in place.

control_results.scope: Historically exposed descriptive human handling; fixed writer/prompt separation. Model suggestions are not human-authored text. Late cheap controls share one separately recorded CPU fit; old reader results, exclusions and central contrasts are unchanged.
